title: Blow-ups at a point of finite density have locally bounded mass
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, let U ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) be open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), x ∈ ℝ^P and θ ∈ ℝ with HasMassDensity T x θ, i.e. θ ≥ 0 and M_{B_ρ(x)}(T)/(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ)) → ofReal θ in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0⁺, where ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝⁿ and M_W = massOn. Let λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0, and S_j := η_{x,λ_j#}T = blowUp T x λ_j ∈ 𝒟_n(η_{x,λ_j}(U)). Then for every R ∈ ℝ there is c ∈ [0, ∞) (c ≠ ∞) such that M_{B_R(0)}(S_j) = S_j.massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c for all large j (eventually in atTop).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < n → HasMassDensity T x θ → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c
